definitions.title: Integration Rules for Products of Powers of Sine and Cosine
definitions.statement:
1. If power of cosine n is odd, save one cos(x) factor (du = cos(x) dx) and express remaining cosines as 1 - sin^2(x).
2. If power of sine m is odd, save one sin(x) factor and express remaining sines as 1 - cos^2(x).
3. If both m and n are even, reduce powers using half-angle identities sin^2(x) = (1 - cos(2x))/2 and cos^2(x) = (1 + cos(2x))/2.
definitions.explanation: Converts high trigonometric powers into polynomial substitutions.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Odd power -> save one factor for du; All even powers -> apply half-angle identities.
